reason: The hypothesis transfers the well-established LCO/precipitate strengthening mechanism from other HEA systems (e.g., AlCrFeTiX, CrCoNi, FeMnCoCrN) to the specific, underexplored equimolar CoCrFeNiTi solid-solution alloy, and proposes a controlled thermal treatment to test whether the lack of such obstacles explains its low strength/high ductility. This is a non-trivial application to a new alloy with a stated mechanistic rationale, going beyond a simple restatement of prior results.
